description: This is a unit test double implementation for the NiaNetworkDataSource interface, providing mock data and behaviors for testing purposes within the Android project. It simulates network data operations, managing change lists and providing methods to retrieve topics and news resources.

classes.name: CollectionType
classes.description: An enum representing different data collections available: Topics and NewsResources.

classes.name: TestNiaNetworkDataSource
classes.description: A test double class implementing NiaNetworkDataSource, providing mock data and change list management for testing.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Returns a list of NetworkTopic objects, optionally filtered by provided IDs.

methods.name: getNewsResources
methods.description: Returns a list of NetworkNewsResource objects, optionally filtered by provided IDs.

methods.name: getTopicChangeList
methods.description: Returns a list of NetworkChangeList objects for topics after a specified version.

methods.name: getNewsResourceChangeList
methods.description: Returns a list of NetworkChangeList objects for news resources after a specified version.

methods.name: latestChangeListVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the latest change list version for the specified collection type.

methods.name: changeListsAfter
methods.description: Retrieves change lists after a specific version for the specified collection.

methods.name: editCollection
methods.description: Modifies the change list for a collection and item ID, simulating server-side updates.
